reasons: Both answers meet every rubric item: local PIN/biometric unlock with re-login only at sync, field-level merge with server revisions, server/TSA signing time, and resumable presigned S3 multipart upload. B ties the parts together more explicitly with a shared act lifecycle state machine and a concrete server-side check that the signed version equals the current draft revision (SignConflict), which directly addresses the stated goal of making the parts fit together. B also covers presigned URL expiry during long uploads and an offline-duration limit as an alternative security control; A is equally correct but slightly less integrated.
